2026-11-04 19:59:41.438426 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-04 19:59:41.438430 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,

2026-11-04 19:59:41.438440 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
